annotation_semantics: final-frame insertion and exit pixels; static material labels, not contact events
source_color_policy: Original source mask RGB bytes are retained; nonzero pixels define label coverage
uv_interpolation: faceVarying; disjoint triangle tiles with filtering gutters
geometry_role: Original tetrahedral exterior boundary triangles and reference vertex indices; replay surface is static
material_transport: With updated triangle vertices X_i(t), the label is sum_i barycentric_i*X_i(t); fixed face-varying UVs travel with that face. This replay does not evolve FEM vertices.
limitations: Bindings are conditional on fitted camera/phantom alignment, not independently measured 3D points.
Static reference tetrahedron exterior is used; recorded tissue deformation is not reconstructed.
Labels remain on their material triangles throughout replay; annotation timing is not grasp/contact timing.
Pad-only rigid placement carries the original material labels; original source-pixel overlap is reported, not forced by rebinding.
display_color_policy: All labelled texels use display_color_rgb for visibility; source pixels and material bindings are unchanged
geometry_hash_scope: World-transformed vertices and triangle indices; authored local geometry arrays remain unchanged
binding_creation_metrics_scope: Source-ray reconstruction and visible-source counts describe binding creation before the rigid pad translation
